verdicts.evidence: The empty spelling cannot pass either call site. At the exported parameter, the very next test rejects it for EVERY root: identity cannot hold because falsy roots are filtered out one line above, and the prefix test cannot hold for any non-empty root. Measured, not reasoned: 12 root shapes built from REAL directories — the process cwd, the repo root, the project root, a nested root, the filesystem root, dot, dot-dot, and four multi-root calls — all null on both builds. At the gate's call site, the argument domain was instrumented over the whole corpus: 4109 observations, 39 distinct values, and every one of the six empty-string observations came from the exported parameter, never from the gate, because the resolver only ever yields null, a sentinel, or a non-empty path. SENSITIVITY CONTROL in the same function and the same return statement: defeating the OTHER conjunct moved 3 of 196 battery cases and killed the unit test that names it. So the battery reaches this function and is sensitive to it; only the empty-string conjunct is inert.
verdicts.mission: reachability mode 'isspelling-domain'; battery Y001-Y012 and S01-S12

verdicts.evidence: Two observable flips. (a) Case B6, as above: the empty spelling is no longer excluded, null becomes 'src'. (b) Case B7, unique to this mutant: a legitimate spelling equal to the marker string is now REFUSED, so the gate drops from 'The file is spelled ...' to the no-remedy message for any file whose path is that string. The 18 remaining battery cases byte-identical; nets all exit 0; all missions identical. Not equivalent (two demonstrated behaviour changes), not display-only (the return is a machine value that also decides WHICH message is emitted), not defence-in-depth (no net moved).
verdicts.mission: direct battery B6 and B7; all missions identical
